### God Is in Charge
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-november-10-2012.html
Passage: Psalm 131:2
Points:
- Daily interruptions and irritations remind us that God, not ourselves, is in control.
- God prioritizes cultivating Christlike character over our personal schedules.
- Difficult circumstances and friction serve as divine tools to mature our faith.
- Just as an oyster forms a pearl around an irritant, quiet peace develops when we submit to God in trials.

### Calm and Quiet in God’s Arms
Author: Wyatt Graham
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/detrinitate/calm-and-quiet-in-gods-arms/
Passage: Psalm 131:1-3
Points:
- Attempting to shoulder burdens meant only for God leads to anxiety, despair, and anger.
- Genuine humility means relinquishing self-sufficiency and accepting creaturely limitations.
- Quieting the soul is an intentional discipline of learning to rest in God's presence.
- Like a weaned child, believers are called to enjoy God Himself rather than constantly clamoring for what He provides.
- Lasting soul-rest comes through placing our enduring hope in the resurrected Lord.
